sections.title: 10 Days of Art, Heritage & Flavors | Paris • Périgord • Bordeaux
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Art, Culture & Heritage

Experience the best of France as you journey from the vibrant streets of Paris to the picturesque Périgord region and the renowned vineyards of Bordeaux. Discover artistic traditions, historic landmarks, and culinary delights, immersing yourself in the rich heritage and flavors that define these iconic French destinations.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Paris
sections.html:
Arrive in Paris and settle in

Arrive in Paris and settle in. Enjoy an introductory stroll through the neighborhood with your tour escort, followed by an evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 2 - Montmartre & the Marais
sections.html:
Discover Montmartre, Sacré-Cœur and Place du Tertre

Discover the artistic spirit of Montmartre, including Sacré-Cœur and Place du Tertre, where painters have gathered for generations.

Explore the Marais district

Continue to the historic Marais district, known for its atmospheric streets and lively cultural scene.

sections.title: Day 3 - Paris to the Périgord: Brantome & Truffles
sections.html:
Travel by train to Angoulême and continue to Périgord

Travel by train to Angoulême, then continue into the picturesque Périgord region.

Explore Brantôme

Explore Brantôme, with its riverside abbey and historic village setting.

Visit a truffle farm

Visit a truffle farm to learn about the prized black truffle, see a truffle-hunting demonstration, and enjoy a tasting.

Overnight in the Montignac area

Overnight in the Montignac area.

sections.title: Day 4 - Sarlat, Beynac Castle & the Dordogne River
sections.html:
Stroll through Sarlat’s medieval lanes and market

Stroll through Sarlat’s medieval lanes and colorful market.

Visit Beynac Castle

Visit imposing Beynac Castle overlooking the Dordogne Valley.

Scenic gabare boat ride on the Dordogne River

Continue to La Roque-Gageac for a scenic ride aboard a traditional flat-bottomed gabare boat on the Dordogne River.

sections.title: Day 5 - Prehistoric Art & Lascaux
sections.html:
Visit Castel Merle

Visit Castel Merle to discover prehistoric artistic traditions.

Limestone relief-sculpture workshop

Take part in a hands-on limestone relief-sculpture workshop using techniques inspired by early art.

Prehistoric-style cuisine demonstration

Enjoy a demonstration of prehistoric-style cuisine.

Explore Lascaux IV

Explore Lascaux IV, an extraordinary recreation of the famed prehistoric cave paintings.

sections.title: Day 6 - Bordeaux: Architecture & Wine Heritage
sections.html:
Journey to Bordeaux

Journey to Bordeaux for a guided exploration of the city’s elegant architecture, including its cathedral, grand opera house, and Place de la Bourse.

Visit La Cité du Vin

Visit La Cité du Vin, an immersive cultural museum devoted to wine and its place in world history.

sections.title: Day 7 - Roman Mosaics & Vineyard Traditions
sections.html:
Discover Gallo-Roman mosaics at Montcaret

Discover the remarkable Gallo-Roman mosaics at Montcaret, where the remains of an ancient villa reveal intricate floors and Roman daily life.

Vineyard tasting and winegrower's lunch

Continue to a vineyard for a regional tasting experience accompanied by a traditional winegrower's lunch.

sections.title: Day 8 - Return to Paris
sections.html:
Travel by train to Paris

Travel by train to Paris.

Afternoon and evening at leisure in Paris

Enjoy the afternoon and evening at leisure to explore museums, galleries, cafés, or favorite neighborhoods at your own pace.

sections.title: Day 9 - Paris Landmarks & Seine River
sections.html:
Discover more of historic Paris, including Sainte-Chapelle and the Notre-Dame area

Discover more of historic Paris, including Sainte-Chapelle and the Notre-Dame area.

Free time near the Eiffel Tower

Enjoy free time near the Eiffel Tower.

Memorable Parisian dining experience

Enjoy a memorable Parisian dining experience.

Cruise along the Seine

Enjoy a cruise along the Seine.

sections.title: Day 10 - Farewell France
sections.html:
Enjoy your final morning before departing for your onward journey home.

Enjoy your final morning before departing for your onward journey home.
